# ============================================

LINK_PAG_CLIENT_ID=e3713650-f520-48cd-ab1d-27a903cafe19

# LINK_PAG_PRODUCAO_URL=https://api.itau.com.br/...

ITAU_KEY_PATH=/etc/ssl/private/itau-key.pem

# --- ODOO ---
ODOO_URL=https://seu-empresa.odoo.com
ODOO_DB=seu-empresa
ODOO_USERNAME=seu-email@empresa.com

# --- MODO MOCK (true para testar sem o Itau) ---

# --- MIDDLEWARE ---
PORT=3000
